pattern.description: Regular expression in ripgrep syntax. Anchored to the workspace root; runner refuses patterns that compile to catastrophic-backtracking forms (e.g. nested unbounded quantifiers).

path.description: Sandbox-scoped directory or file under which to search. Accepts 'sandbox://<path>'. Defaults to the workspace root when omitted. Absolute filesystem paths are rejected.

glob.description: Optional glob filter restricting which files are searched (e.g. '**/*.ts', 'src/**/*.{js,mjs}'). Multiple filters can be joined with commas.

case_sensitive.description: When false (default), pattern matches are case-insensitive. Set true for exact-case identifier hunts.

max_results.description: Soft cap on matches returned to the planner. Runner truncates and sets 'truncated: true' rather than streaming unbounded output.

context_lines.description: Number of surrounding lines to attach to each match (before and after). Zero returns only the matching line.

matches.description: Ordered match list. Empty array means no hits, not failure.

truncated.description: True when the runner stopped at max_results before exhausting the corpus. Re-run with a narrower glob or higher cap to see the rest.

files_scanned.description: Diagnostic count of files examined. Useful for verifying glob narrowing actually reduced scope.

summary: Workspace-scoped regex code search via ripgrep. Read-only, sub-second on typical repos.
